issue_context.title: [Feature]:  Customizable Junit Output for title
issue_context.body:
### 🚀 Feature Request

Allow the customizing of the Junit Output, specifically in our case the title.

The current code removes the project and other parts : 

```
      attributes: {
        // Skip root, project, file
        name: test.titlePath().slice(3).join(' › '),
        // filename
        classname: suiteName,
        time: (test.results.reduce((acc, value) => acc + value.duration, 0)) / 1000

      },
```

### Example


In Azure Devops it's hard to differentiate between one testcase run against multiple projects:
the below is from 4 different projects.
![image](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/assets/37447884/53479452-0119-4abb-898c-27dee8b9fe3a)



### Motivation

My use case is in Azure devops, but there are many different CI/CD Systems, to it would be IDEAL if we could provide a template like jest-junit but anything to start off with would be good!

or a way for us to easily override parts of the junit-reporters, without having to hack into the imports of playwright

review_comments: We have a new guidelines - all the reporter properties should be configurable via env. That way they can be merged w/o additional config.
Sounds good, I will follow up with env vars for all the options.
